main_text.head: א ש
main_text.p: לְאֵשׁ[?] ad ignem, præf. cum No. Rad. אשׁ.
הֲאֵשׁ[?] sitne, pro יֵשׁ[?] præf. Rad. יָשָׁה.
אֶשָּׂא[?] feram, אֶשָּׂאֲנוּ[?] portavero eum, 1. sing. fut. Kal, aff. Rad. נָשָׂא.
אַשְׁאִיר[?] reliquum faciam, 1. f. fut. Hiph. R. שָׁאַר.
אֵשְׁבָּה[?], אֶשְׁבָה sedebo, 1. f. fut. Kal, parag. Rad. יָשַׁב.
אָשַׁב vel אָשׁוּב revertar, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. שׁוּב.
וָאֵשֵׁב[?] & respondi, 1. f. fut. Hiph. R. שׁוּב.
אֶשְׂבַּע[?], vel, שָׂבַע satiabor, 1. sing. fut. Niph. Rad. שָׂבַע.
אֶשְׁבַּע adjurabo, אֶשְׁבַּע[?], vel, שְׁבַּע saturabo, 1. f. fut. Hiph. Rad. שָׂבַע & שָׂבַע.
אֶשְׁנֶה errabo, fut. Kal, 1. f. R. שָׁנָה.
אִשָּׁה, אִשֶּׁה ignitum sacri-ficium, No. f. m. à No. R. אֵשׁ ignis.
אִשָּׁה fæmina, sing. fæm. No. Rad. אִישׁ vir.
אִשּׁוֹ[?] ignis ejus, םֶ eorum, אִשְׁכֶם[?] vester, aff. cum No. Rad. אשׁ.
אֲשׁוּהָ[?] æqualis ero, 1. sing. fut. Kal. אֶשְׁוֶה æquabo, 1. f. fut. Hiph. Rad. שָׁוָה.
אֶשְׁחַחַ[?] inclinabo, 1. sing. fut. Piel, vel Poel; Rad. שׁוּחַ, vel שָׁחַח.
אֶשְׁוַע[?] vociferabor, 1. f. fut. Piel, parag. Rad. שָׁוַע, vel שׁוּעַ.
אֲשׁוּר[?], אָשׁוּר incessus, יִם[?] · incessus, י mei, יו ejus, &c. No. sing. m. & pl. m. aff. Rad. אָשַׁר incessit.
אֶשּׁוּרֶנּוּ[?] contemplabor eum, 1. f. fut. Kal. aff. R. שׁוּר.
אַשְׁחָה natare faciam, fut. Hiph. 1. f. R. שָׂחָה.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are hard to read at this scan resolution; forms marked [?] are approximate. The ם and י signs before "eorum", "incessus" and "ejus" are small printed Hebrew suffix letters and may be misplaced. The entries are set with hanging indents and each is treated as its own paragraph. No marginal notes or footnotes are printed on this page.
